name: 02-saturation
description: Overload comparison: the same offered load is run under all four control modes (none, static concurrency, request-rate limit, adaptive AIMD). The matrix runner first measures sustainable capacity with a load ramp, then scales this scenario's tenant mix so the total offered load is 2x that measured capacity - the overload factor is measured, not asserted. Expect 429s with Retry-After and TTFT growth under the uncontrolled modes, and bounded TTFT with higher qualified goodput under adaptive control.
